title: The sources reference data cites
description: Every field of every record names one of these (PL-10). A source is a published document, by its URL, or a document in this repository, by its path; a test checks the path exists. The loader refuses a field that names a source not listed here, and a test refuses a source nothing names. The platform's own data cites sources.json at the root, and a module's set the sources.json in its own directory. A source whose data is copied or computed from, rather than read and restated, records the licence it is used under.

licence.description: The licence or terms the source's data is used under, and what they ask of whoever uses it.
